name: Destructive Deliberation / actual-opponent-sigil-response-before-token-resolution
notes: Printed source cost2/power5/pitch1/defense2. Physical damage max(0,5-0)=5. Hero target; printed hero-only condition produces 1 independent layer(s) and no earlier token. Actual opponent Sigil red resolves for+3HP above original hit layer before token creation. Creation preserves original canonical token helper/controller. Current attack has no go again, no AP refund. Real Close moves physical cards to their owners; destroyed Ward/ally tokens cease outsideArena. Normal bookkeeping fields are not asserted empty.
